messages:
Maya Patel: Quick sync — I'm starting the handshake for canary metric ingest. Need to lock down the wire format, required labels, and panel mappings before we flip telemetry on for canary-2026-03. cc @Ranjit @Lucas @Tara
Ranjit Singh: Which signals are we prioritizing? p95 latency, backend error-rate, token-cost-delta? Any custom model-quality signals?
Lucas Chen: Minimum set I'd expect: p50, p95, error_rate(success=false), token_cost_per_request, request_count. Also need route_id, rollout_bucket, region, model_variant tags so dashboards can slice.
Tara Gomez: +1. Also include experiment_id or canary_id so A/B join queries are simpler. Are we adding quota_group and policy_name too? We often need quota for regressions.
Maya Patel: Yes on canary_id and quota_group. Proposal: require these labels on ingest: route, canary_id, rollout_bucket, quota_group, model_variant, region, env (prod/stage).
Lucas Chen: Can we append a small schema here? Proposed wire format (flat):
```
metric_name: string
value: number
timestamp_ms: int64
labels: {
  route: string,
  canary_id: string,
  rollout_bucket: string,
  quota_group: string,
  model_variant: string,
  region: string,
  env: string
}
```
Ranjit Singh: That looks fine but watch cardinality: route+model_variant+region can explode. We should require a sampling knob at ingest or a cardinality guard. Also add tag `slice_key` for op-defined slice (e.g., user_cohort) instead of many custom labels.
Maya Patel: Good call. We'll make `slice_key` optional and add a per-route cardinality limit enforced by the metrics pipeline (reject >50 distinct keys per minute).
Tara Gomez: For dashboards: need a pairwise-diff panel (control vs canary), a heatmap for regressions across slices, and an alert panel for p95+error regression combined. We should also expose a per-route widget in Console showing the rollout_bucket split.
Lucas Chen: For alerting, propose a combined rule: trigger when (delta_p95 > 20% AND delta_error_rate > 0.5%) over 10m with traffic >= 500 requests. Can we get delta computed in the metrics pipeline?
Maya Patel: Pipeline will publish comparison series: control_* and canary_*. We'll add precomputed ratios/deltas to save dashboard compute. Name them like `delta:p95:route:canary_vs_control`.
infra-bot: metrics-pipeline: created dataset `canary_metrics_v1`, retention 30d, schema locked. Ingest endpoint: https://metrics.redwood.internal/ingest/canary_v1
Ranjit Singh: Ownership: eng-platform owns the dashboard templates and schema. eng-runtime owns the runtime tags and rollout_bucket injection. observability team (Tara) owns alert rules and Prometheus->Grafana mapping.
Tara Gomez: Agreed. I'll add the alerting config to the prometheus-rules repo and drop a PR once the pipeline is ready for backfill.
Maya Patel: Backfill plan — runtime will emit for last 7 days from canary job; platform will run reconciliation to map old route names. We'll validate deltas on staging first.
Lucas Chen: One more: add `ingest_version` label to support non-breaking changes later.
Maya Patel: Good. I'll open an RFC and a small PR to the pipeline proto. Also will create the dashboard template skeleton and assign owners.
Ranjit Singh: :thumbsup: Can someone add a short example event payload to the RFC? makes onboarding easier.
Maya Patel: Will do. Thanks everyone — sync in #oncall tomorrow to review the first ingested sample.
Tara Gomez: :raised_hands:
Lucas Chen: Thanks!
infra-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled job metrics-pipeline.deploy at 2026-03-22T02:00:00Z
